title: Initial guard condition
statement: For any nondeterministic register program, oracle, input, and predicate $G$, if every choice word of length $N+1$ from the configuration $(l,v,r)$ leads to a halted configuration and all earlier nonhalted configurations satisfy $G$, then $G$ holds of $(l,v,r)$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic register program, oracle, input, and predicate $G$
A state $l$, register valuation $v$, result value $r$, and natural number $N$
Every run from $(l,v,r)$ on a choice word of length $N+1$ halts and has $G$ at every earlier nonhalted configuration
